== Summary ==

:{{pov|[[Nynaeve al'Meara]]}}
Nynaeve, [[Elayne]], [[Birgitte]], and [[Aviendha]] are in their rooms in the [[Tarasin Palace]]. The other [[Aes Sedai]] in the Palace do not accept that Elayne and Nynaeve are Aes Sedai. [[Adeleas]] and [[Vandene]] are supposedly looking for runaways from the [[White Tower|Tower]]. Elayne and Nynaeve doubt that; they think Adeleas and Vandene are going to try to find the ''[[ter'angreal]]'' that can fix the weather. 

A servant arrives and invites the three Aes Sedai for an audience, but only Elayne and Nynaeve go since Aviendha is not an Aes Sedai. After some frank discussion, they win [[Tylin]] over and have a more intimate discussion rather than an audience with a queen. They tell Tylin everything about their search for the [[Bowl of the Winds|bowl]] and get her promise to help if she can. They are introduced to her sole surviving son, [[Beslan]], to whom she hopes to pass on her throne. Elayne believes they can wrap up their mission in ten days and get back to [[Egwene]].

===Sayings===
Lean back on your knife and let your tongue go free. -Saying in Ebou Dar meaning "Be at ease and speak your mind as you wish." According to [[Elayne]], the only way to insult somebody who says that to you is to lie.
